title: The Crysis Mod
description: A world of features inspired by the 'Crysis' franchise.
body:
The Crysis Mod is a Minecraft mod that adds Items & Armors from the fps game 'Crysis' by 'Crytek.'

The main feature of the mod is the Nanosuit a set of armor which allows the player to switch between 4 major modes:
 - Armor Mode: Invincibility. 
 - Strength Mode: Jump and attack damage boost
 - Speed Mode: Running and swimming super fast
 - Cloak Mode: Invisibility.
All of these features only last as long as your energy supply which recharges quickly when not in use.

How to play:

    Crafting The Suit:
        To craft a suit you must mine for the new: "Mysterious Fossil."
        There are two kinds of mysterious fossil. 
        There is a small fossil that is 1x1 block.
        There is also a large fossil that is made up of multiple "Mysterious Fossil Block"s

        Once you have your mysterious fossils you can smelt them to obtain "Nano Catalyst"
        Combine "Nano Catalyst" with leather to obtain "Nano Fibers"
        And Combine a specific amount of "Nano Fibers" with specific vanilla armors to obtain the "Nano Suits"

    The Suit Mode Switcher:
        Once you have a suit, press and hold the "Suit Mode Switcher" key (Default: 'V') to open a menu
        from which you can switch your suits mode by moving your mouse in the direction of the mode you want.
        Once the arrow is pointing at the desired mode, release the "Suit Mode Switcher" key.

    The Visor:
        The visor is activated by key press (Default: 'B'). This is a form of binoculars, but is entirely avaliable within your suit.
        - You can use the visor to scan mobs giving them an outline like unto the 'Glowing' effect, only you can see the mob's outline though

    Upgrades:
        Your suit can be upgraded with more "Nano Catalyst" items through the upgrade menu.
        To access the upgrade menu, you can press the "Upgrade Menu" key (Default: 'H').
        In this menu you can unlock, disable, and reenable upgrades at will.

    Have Fun.
